data.display_address: One River Point, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
One River Point, a prestigious development by Ellington, is located along the Dubai Canal in the sought-after Business Bay area. This luxurious tower boasts a design that merges contemporary style with unparalleled elegance, making it a standout architectural gem. The project offers 1-3-bedroom apartments, each with expansive panoramic windows that frame stunning views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, and the Persian Gulf.

Residents of the complex have access to exclusive services and amenities. To ensure maximum comfort, there are several swimming pools, including a children's pool, a state-of-the-art gym, yoga and fitness studios, children's playgrounds and a virtual reality zone. The complex has a large landscaped garden with recreation areas, various sports fields and running and cycling paths, as well as concierge services, 24-hour security and parking.

In the immediate vicinity there are cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, kindergartens and schools. Business Bay has convenient connections to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road — the two main highways that pass through Dubai, which will allow residents of the complex to quickly reach key places in the city.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
